summary: Comprehensive testing of Interior Design Project Management app - Item transfers, Photo management, UI elements, and navigation features. All key features working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: ✅ No duplicate/non-functional search bar on Walkthrough page - correctly removed from MainContainer.js
✅ No Export/Spec Sheet buttons on Walkthrough page - correctly removed
✅ Walkthrough page has only: filter dropdowns, ADD ROOM button, TRANSFER TO CHECKLIST button
✅ Walkthrough page loads with project data and shows spreadsheet with rooms/items
✅ Checkboxes in walkthrough spreadsheet work - clicking checks/unchecks items
✅ Transfer to Checklist button is visible and accessible
✅ Photo Management section is collapsed by default (▶ indicator visible)
✅ Photo Management expands to show room folders when clicked
✅ PhotoManagerModal opens when clicking room folder - shows Take Photo and Upload Photos buttons
✅ Checklist page loads correctly and shows transferred items
✅ Transfer to FFE button exists on Checklist page
✅ Navigation tabs (WALKTHROUGH, CHECKLIST, FF&E, WHOLE HOME FINISHES) work correctly
✅ Backend API endpoints all working (17/17 tests passed)

walkthrough_page.details: Loads with project data, shows spreadsheet with Living Room, categories (Furniture, Lighting), and items. No duplicate search bar or Export/Spec Sheet buttons.

checkboxes.details: Checkboxes can be checked/unchecked. Clicking saves PICKED status to backend.

transfer_to_checklist.details: Button visible and accessible. Transfer logic creates room/category/item structure in checklist sheet.

photo_management.details: Collapsed by default. Expands to show: Photos Captured, Measurements Added, Rooms Photographed stats, and room folders.

photo_manager_modal.details: Opens when clicking room folder. Shows 'Take Photo' and 'Upload Photos' buttons.

checklist_page.details: Loads correctly, shows sync panel for walkthrough data, Status Overview, Photo Management section.

transfer_to_ffe.details: Button visible on Checklist page at bottom of filter section.

navigation_tabs.details: WALKTHROUGH, CHECKLIST, FF&E, WHOLE HOME FINISHES tabs navigate correctly to respective pages.

seed_data_creation: Used existing project 'Test Transfer Project' with Living Room containing Furniture and Lighting categories
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested features verified working: 1) Login works, 2) No duplicate search/export buttons on Walkthrough, 3) Walkthrough spreadsheet with checkboxes works, 4) Transfer to Checklist button present, 5) Photo Management collapsed by default, expands with room folders, 6) PhotoManagerModal has Take/Upload Photo buttons, 7) Checklist page loads with Transfer to FFE button, 8) Navigation tabs work correctly. Backend APIs all passing (17/17 tests).
